label: measured
what: One real station-gateway process, driven by simulated stations. Raw per-second samples are in `samples`.

setup.gateway: ONE native node process (no docker), real Redis and Kafka (3 brokers, RF 3, acks=all) from compose host ports, raw-log publishing ON, GATEWAY_MAX_UPGRADES_PER_S=3000 (default 300 is sized for 167 reconnects/s), other settings default
setup.sessions: stub HTTP server in the runner process (instant answers, no database)
setup.simulator: separate process: 10000 stations (1000 sites x 10), SIM_TIME_SCALE=20, SIM_START 18:00 UTC (evening peak), connect ramp 1000/s
setup.machine: 8 logical CPUs, darwin arm64; gateway, simulator, runner, Redis and Kafka all share this one machine
setup.topics: unique per run, created with 12 partitions RF 3, deleted afterwards

notes: loopLag* come from perf_hooks monitorEventLoopDelay with a 10 ms resolution, so an idle loop reads about 10 ms. msgIn/msgOut count OCPP frames (all types) from the gateway ocpp_messages_total counter.
